biography.value:
NORMI CONSCRIPT GUARD — CR 1/4 mook (run several). Normi conscript guarding the staging mine near Dhul Maldur; Korrun Slagledger's shields. No scaleweaving, expendable, knows it.

Manual — Pack Tactics: toggle the Pack Tactics effect OFF when no ally is within 5 ft of the target (on by default).

Manual — Conscript's Divide (morale/RP switch): overseer watching → fights dutifully, afraid of him. Overseer flees / an ally drops / shown mercy / cornered → morale breaks: roll or RP — may FLEE, SURRENDER, or LOOK AWAY (let a PC slip past). Some are quietly decent.

Manual: spear can be thrown (range 20/60).

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.desc: Melee weapon attack: 1d6+1 piercing on a hit. Manual: can be thrown (range 20/60).

abilities.name: Light Crossbow
abilities.desc: Ranged weapon attack, range 80 ft: 1d8+1 piercing on a hit.
